symptoms.symptom: The refrigeration unit is switching on more frequently and for longer.

causes.label: The appliance has been opened frequently.
remedies: Do not open appliance door unnecessarily.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 16: "The appliance has been opened frequently."

causes.label: The exterior ventilation grilles are blocked.
remedies: Remove any obstructions from in front of the exterior ventilation grilles.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 16: "The exterior ventilation grilles are blocked."

causes.label: Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines switch on more frequently and have different power levels to cool more efficiently.
remedies: Remove any obstructions from in front of the exterior ventilation grilles.
Install the appliance as far away as possible from heating elements, cookers and other heat sources.
Avoid prolonged exposure of the appliance to direct sunlight.
Page 14 Only open the appliance door as briefly as necessary.
Allow hot food and drinks to cool down first before storing in the appliance.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 16: "Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines switch on more frequently and have different power levels to cool more efficiently."

symptoms.symptom: The temperature differs greatly from the setting.

causes.label: Different causes are possible.
remedies: Switch the appliance back on after five minutes.
Page 11 If the temperature is too warm, check the temperature again after a couple of hours.
If the temperature is too cold, check the temperature again on the following day.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 16: "Different causes are possible."

symptoms.symptom: The appliance hums, bubbles, buzzes, gargles or clicks.

causes.label: Not a fault. A motor is running, e.g. refrigerating unit, fan. Refrigerant flows through the pipes. The motor, switches or solenoid valves are switching on or off. No action required.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 16: "Not a fault. A motor is running, e.g. refrigerating unit, fan. Refrigerant flows through the pipes. The motor, switches or solenoid valves are switching on or off. No action required."

causes.label: Fittings wobble or stick.
remedies: Check the removable fittings and, if required, replace these.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 17: "Fittings wobble or stick."

causes.label: Super freezing is switched on. No action required.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 17: "Super freezing is switched on. No action required."
